description: This file declares the exported APIs for the HTTP Simple Proxy Object, including functions for creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization.

methods.name: HttpCreateSimpleProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance of the HTTP Simple Proxy object with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: HttpSpoCreate
methods.description: Initializes and creates the HTTP Simple Proxy object with given contexts.

methods.name: HttpSpoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the specified HTTP Simple Proxy object.

methods.name: HttpSpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects within the HTTP Simple Proxy context.

methods.name: HttpSpoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Simple Proxy object.
